ruleDefinitions.name: Pass the Hash Activity 2
ruleDefinitions.description: Detects the attack technique pass the hash which is used to move laterally inside the network Note: Unmapped fields: SubjectUserSid, LogonType, LogonProcessName, KeyLength

sequences.query: ((event_id = 4624 AND SubjectUserSid = "S\-1\-0\-0" AND LogonType = 3 AND LogonProcessName = "NtLmSsp" AND KeyLength = 0) OR (event_id = 4624 AND LogonType = 9 AND LogonProcessName = "seclogo")) AND  NOT (dest_user = "ANONYMOUS\ LOGON")
